scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof and standalone finite checker. Classical Fourier character and binomial lemmas are credited. No claim of independence or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime sizes, odd independent unshifted rank-one generators in two dimensions, and the stated finite Fourier-slope subspace only.
The norm is a finite-dimensional \(L^2\) norm, not a smoothness-normalized Korobov norm uniformly in prime size.
No conclusion about randomly shifted rules, adaptive generator selection, or coefficient reconstruction.
Specialist publication priority remains uncertain; no independent scientific validation.
title: Sharp majority-occupancy law for median rank-one lattice quadrature
